operations.title: The integral occurrence-resolved Cousin cokernel is torsion-free
operations.body: In primitive local Betti bases, the six-occurrence source incidence map is Z -> Z^6, 1 maps to (1,1,1,1,1,1), with Smith invariant 1 and cokernel Z^5. In the quarter-enlarged source-normalized e6 lattice the same integral boundary has coordinates (4,4,4,4,4,4), Smith invariant 4 and cokernel Z^5 plus Z/4. Therefore the order-four class is a de Rham/Betti lattice mismatch, not torsion in physical integral hypercohomology. Occurrence forgetting similarly manufactures a Z/2 multiplicity.

operations.title: Integral versus quarter-enlarged Cousin Smith checker
operations.body: The checker verifies Smith invariants 1, 4, and 2 for the occurrence-resolved Betti, quarter-enlarged e6, and occurrence-forgotten maps respectively.
